Definition: Retsin, the name of a Syrian and of an Israelite
BiblicalUsage: Rezin = "firm"; 1) king of Damascus during the reigns of kings Jotham and Ahaz of Judah; 2) the progenitor of a family of temple slaves who returned from captivity with Zerubbabel
